rules.rationale: Four or more request-known attempts within 60 seconds.
Five or more processed attempts within five minutes.
Three or more distinct cards within 24 hours.
At least two consecutive prior processor declines.
A prior decline is followed by card switching.
At least three sessions and four prior attempts over seven days.
Eight or more request-known attempts on the IP within five minutes.
Low-value behavior is supporting evidence only when cards vary.
